title: How Much Does a Website Cost in Vasai and Mumbai?
description: A plain-English guide to website pricing in Vasai and Mumbai: what a basic site, a full custom site and a web app cost in rupees, and what changes the price.
keywords: website cost in Vasai, website cost Mumbai, how much does a website cost in India, web design price Vasai
excerpt: Basic business sites start around ₹15,000. A custom 5 to 6 page site starts at ₹25,000. Here is what moves the number up or down.
body:
Everyone asks the same first question: **how much will my website cost?** The honest answer is "it depends", so here is what it depends on, with real rupee ranges from our own projects in Vasai and Mumbai.

## The short answer

- **A basic business website** (a few simple sections, your contact details, a form) typically costs **₹15,000 to ₹30,000**.
- **A full custom website** with animations and several sections typically costs **₹30,000 to ₹80,000**.
- **Our usual minimum for a custom 5 to 6 page website is ₹25,000.**
- **Web apps, dashboards and portals** are scoped individually because the work varies enormously.

You can get a quick range for your own project with the [estimator on our contact page](/contact#estimate).

## What changes the price

### 1. How many pages you need
A one-page site and a 12-page site are different jobs. Every extra page needs design, content layout, testing on mobile and SEO setup.

### 2. Custom design vs a template
A template looks cheaper at first, but you pay for it later in speed, SEO and the "your site looks like everyone else's" problem. Custom design takes more time up front, which is why it costs more. We [explain the SEO side in this article](/blog/why-website-templates-hurt-seo).

### 3. Features
A contact form is simple. Booking, payments, a customer login, a CMS you can edit yourself or integrations with other tools all add scope.

### 4. Timeline
A standard business website takes **1 to 3 weeks**. Complex projects with branding included take **3 to 6 weeks**. Rushing a project means other work gets pushed aside, so fast-track timelines cost more.

### 5. Content and branding
If you already have a logo, photos and copy, the project moves faster. If we also need to design a logo and brand system, that is a separate piece of work. See our [branding services](/branding-agency-vasai).

## What is usually *not* included in the quote

Be clear on these before you sign anything:

- Domain name and hosting (these are yearly costs paid to the provider)
- Professional photography
- Ongoing maintenance, unless you take a maintenance package
- Paid ads and marketing

## How to compare quotes

Do not compare only the final number. Ask each studio:

1. Is the site built from scratch or from a template or page builder?
2. Will it be fast on a phone? Ask for a PageSpeed score of a previous project.
3. Is SEO set up (titles, descriptions, schema, headings) or is that extra?
4. Who owns the code and design when the project ends?
5. What happens after launch?

## Want a number for your project?

Send us your brief and we will reply with a clear quote within 24 hours. No commitments. [Start a project](/contact) or [run the free website audit](/free-website-audit) first to see where your current site stands.

title: Why Website Templates Can Hurt Your SEO (and What to Do Instead)
description: Templates and page builders ship extra code, slow your pages and limit your SEO control. Here is how that affects rankings and what a hand-built site does differently.
keywords: website templates SEO, WordPress theme slow, hand-coded website SEO, page builder SEO, custom website SEO
excerpt: Templates are fast to launch, but the extra code, plugins and generic structure can quietly cost you rankings. Here is what to check.
body:
Templates are popular for a good reason: they get a site online quickly. But if you depend on Google for customers, a template can quietly work against you. This is not an attack on every template. It is a list of the specific problems to look for.

## 1. Extra code means slower pages

A typical multipurpose theme loads scripts, fonts and styles for features you never use: sliders, mega menus, animation libraries, icon packs. Visitors on a mid-range phone and a mobile connection feel that delay. Google measures it too, through **Core Web Vitals** such as Largest Contentful Paint and layout shift.

A hand-built site ships only the code the page needs.

## 2. Plugins stack up

Page builders and CMS themes often depend on plugins for forms, SEO, caching and security. Each plugin is more code to load, more to update and more to break. Outdated plugins are also a common way sites get hacked, which hurts both your visitors and your rankings.

## 3. Generic heading and page structure

Search engines use headings, link structure and semantic HTML to understand a page. Many templates are built for looks first. You can end up with several H1s, headings chosen for size rather than meaning, and layout built from nested containers instead of clear sections.

## 4. Limited control over structured data

Schema markup tells search engines who you are, where you are and what you offer. For a local business that means address, opening hours, services and FAQs. Some templates give you little control over this, or add generic markup that does not match your business.

## 5. Everyone looks the same

When thousands of sites share one layout, nothing signals your brand. That affects click-through and enquiries, even if rankings hold.

## What a custom-built site does differently

- **Clean, minimal HTML and CSS** that loads fast on mobile
- **One H1 per page** and a heading outline that matches your content
- **Structured data written for your business**, not a generic plugin
- **Individual titles, descriptions and canonical URLs** on every page
- **Real local landing pages** for the areas you serve, such as [Vasai](/web-design-company-vasai) and [Mumbai](/web-design-company-mumbai)

## How to check your current site

1. Run your homepage through Google PageSpeed Insights on mobile.
2. View the page source and check for one H1 and a unique title.
3. Look for a sitemap at /sitemap.xml and a robots.txt file.
4. Check whether your business details appear as structured data.

Or skip the manual work: use our [free website audit](/free-website-audit) and we will check these basics for you.

## Is a template ever fine?

Yes, for a quick test, a short-term campaign or a very small budget. But if your website is a main source of customers, building it properly is one of the cheapest long-term SEO decisions you can make. See [how we build](/about) or [start a project](/contact).

title: Website Checklist for Doctors and Clinics
description: A practical 12-point website checklist for doctors and clinics: Google Business Profile, appointments, mobile speed, local SEO, schema and patient trust.
keywords: website for doctors, clinic website checklist, doctor website SEO, medical website design India
excerpt: Patients search before they call. Use this 12-point checklist to see whether your clinic website is helping or hurting.
body:
Patients Google before they call. They look for your clinic name, your speciality and the nearest option, usually on a phone. If your site is slow, hard to read or missing basic details, they move on to the next result. Use this checklist to see where you stand.

## The 12 checks

### Be found

1. **Claim your Google Business Profile.** Add your exact address, phone number, opening hours, services and photos. Keep the name, address and phone number identical everywhere.
2. **Have a page for each service you offer.** "Dental implants", "skin treatment" or "paediatric care" each deserve their own page so people searching for them can land on it.
3. **Target how people actually search.** Phrases like "dentist in Vasai" or "skin doctor in Mumbai" matter more than generic words. Our [local pages](/web-design-company-vasai) work the same way.
4. **Add structured data.** Schema markup lets Google show your address, hours and FAQs correctly.

### Make it easy to act

5. **Put the phone number and a WhatsApp button at the top.** Most patients are on mobile and want to call or message, not fill a long form.
6. **Show how to book.** A clear "Book an appointment" button, or a short form, on every page.
7. **Show opening hours and the map.** Include landmarks and parking information if it helps.

### Build trust

8. **Introduce the doctors.** Photo, qualifications, registration details and areas of practice.
9. **Show real patient reviews.** Link to your Google reviews and ask happy patients to leave one.
10. **Explain procedures in plain language.** Answer the questions patients ask most: cost, duration, recovery.

### Technical basics

11. **Make it load fast on mobile.** Aim for pages that are usable within a couple of seconds on an average phone connection.
12. **Protect patient data.** Use HTTPS, keep forms minimal and do not collect medical details through a basic contact form.

## Common mistakes

- A homepage that is only a logo and a phone number
- Stock photos instead of the actual clinic and team
- A "Contact us" form that nobody monitors
- Text that is too small to read on a phone
